sources.entry: reader - Feed reader web app and library (so you can use it to build your own), with only standard library and pure-Python dependencies. BSD-3-Clause Python

summary.one_liner: reader is a Python feed reader library (with optional Flask web app and CLI) for retrieving, storing, and managing Atom, RSS, and JSON feeds.
summary.what_it_does: reader retrieves and stores Atom, RSS, and JSON feeds, and lets you mark entries as read or important. It supports tags and arbitrary metadata on feeds and articles, filtering, and full-text search over articles. It also provides feed and user activity statistics, OPML import/export, automatic feed discovery in web pages, and a plugin system. The README describes it as a library designed so you can build feed reader applications without business code or a specific web framework. Optionally, it ships a web application based on Flask, Bootstrap, and htmx, and a command-line interface.
use_cases: build a custom feed reader application
read and track articles from RSS or Atom feeds
import or export subscriptions as OPML
automatically discover feeds on web pages
notable: Library-first design: a fat model with no dependence on a particular web framework
Stable, clearly documented API with fully typed Python
Full-text search over articles with highlighted matches
Optional web app and command-line interface
caveats: The README does not describe the web app's deployment or configuration steps beyond installing the package
Documentation is hosted externally at reader.readthedocs.io
